//: Copy this file to api_keys.json and fill in your own secrets. api_keys.json is gitignored.
//openai: Used for speech-to-text (gpt-4o-transcribe) and, when voice_backend=openai, the Realtime voice.
//voice_backend: openai = OpenAI Realtime, gemini = Gemini Live. If OpenAI runs out of credit the app fails over to Gemini automatically for that run.
//local_whisper_model: Offline faster-whisper fallback used when OpenAI STT is unusable (no credit / bad key). base = fast (~0.5x realtime on CPU), small = more accurate on Kazakh but ~1.5x realtime.
//obsidian: Obsidian Local REST API plugin. Token comes from the plugin settings.
//ambient_vision: Continuous screen awareness. interval is seconds between frames; min_diff skips near-identical frames (0-255 scale).
//intent_router: Runs unambiguous commands (сверка, создать таблицу/документ) in CODE before the model decides, then lets the model narrate the finished result. Measured 2026-08-17: leaving the decision to the live model gave 25-94% on identical input. Set false to send everything to the model as before.
//unattended_speech: Lets JARVIS start a PAID turn on its own (proactive check-ins, topic alerts, system-metric alerts) while nobody is talking to it. ~3 turns/hour of idle time, each re-billing the full ~18k-token preamble. Left on by accident this drained an OpenAI balance in 2 days. Default off.
//session_budget_usd: Hard cap on metered voice spend per session, 0 = no cap. When reached, voice pauses instead of spending more.
//realtime_prices: Optional override of the gpt-realtime price table (USD per 1M tokens) used by the spend meter, e.g. {"audio_out": 64.0}.
